digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow completion verifier and resumption mechanism
propositions: Frontier exclusion-list block inserted into ticket context does not reduce re-search overlap compared to control because the fence renders data-shaped directives inert by design, and the model repeats searches listed in the frontier block in resumed attempts.
Treatment arm shows +78% and +60% relative INCREASE in overlap rate on two test tickets versus control arm (fails the >=30% reduction requirement), violating the predeclared GO criterion.
The frontier block acts as a signpost naming files where evidence lives, causing resumed runs to re-read those files immediately, raising measured overlap rather than reducing it.

Argument-level tool-call transcripts with full parameters (paths, patterns, file lists) cannot be captured by production telemetry today; the PoC captured them harness-side via monkeypatching completion_verdict_cache and the tool executor seam.
